autoresponder.title: Auto-Responder
autoresponder.description: Learn how to set up automatic responses to incoming emails with queue status and AI-powered answers.

section0.title: What is the Auto-Responder?
section0.content: The Auto-Responder automatically sends replies to incoming emails, letting senders know their message has been received and providing helpful information about when they can expect a response. It can also answer common questions using AI based on the Q&A context you've configured.

section1.title: Enabling the Auto-Responder
section1.content: To enable the Auto-Responder, go to Settings and scroll to the Auto-Responder section. Toggle the switch to enable automatic responses. Once enabled, you'll see additional configuration options.

section2.title: Customizing Response Templates
section2.content: You can customize the message templates that are sent for different priority levels. Use merge tags like {{userName}} and {{queuePosition}} to personalize responses with dynamic information. The template editor shows a live preview of how your message will appear.

section3.title: Exclusion Rules
section3.content: Not every email should receive an auto-response. Use exclusion rules to prevent auto-responses from being sent to certain senders or types of emails. For example, you might want to exclude newsletters, automated notifications, or emails from specific domains.

section4.title: AI-Powered Answers
section4.content: When enabled, the Auto-Responder can attempt to answer common questions based on the Q&A pairs in your context settings. You can set a minimum confidence threshold to control how certain the AI must be before including an answer. All AI-generated answers include a disclaimer that you will confirm the information.

section5.title: Best Practices
section5.item0: Keep your response templates professional and concise
section5.item1: Set up exclusion rules for newsletters and automated emails
section5.item2: Regularly review and update your Q&A context for accurate AI answers
section5.item3: Use the email preview feature to test how responses will look before enabling

hero.description: BearlyMail batches non-urgent emails and delivers them on your schedule. Urgent emails break through immediately. Your inbox becomes a planned task, not a constant distraction.

intro.heading: Why BearlyMail Exists
intro.description: Email was designed for asynchronous communication, but it's become a constant interruption. BearlyMail brings back the original promise: check your email when it works for you, not when it works for everyone else.

comparison.heading: How BearlyMail Compares
comparison.superhumanQuestion: "What do you want to do with this email?"
comparison.bearlyMailQuestion: "When do you want to see this email?"

highlight.gmail: Gmail: Free, but no batching or prioritization
highlight.superhuman: Superhuman: Fast, but still shows all emails immediately
highlight.bearlyMail: BearlyMail: Batches non-urgent emails, prioritizes by importance, learns your preferences
highlight.learning: BearlyMail learns what's urgent to you by analyzing your email behavior

urgentFiltering.label: Urgent Filtering
urgentFiltering.bearlyMail: AI learns what's urgent to you

urgent-emails.title: Truly urgent emails break through immediately

description.0: Client emergency at 2pm? You'll see it instantly. Newsletter from that SaaS tool? Batched until your next scheduled delivery.
description.1: Our AI learns what's urgent to you by analyzing your email history—how quickly you reply, which senders you prioritize, what you immediately archive. High barrier for "urgent" means only what genuinely matters interrupts your flow.

scheduled-delivery.title: Everything else arrives on your schedule

description.0: Choose when emails get delivered: 2x, 3x, or 4x daily. Set quiet hours—no email before 10am, none after 6pm. Block off entire weekends. You're in complete control.
description.1: Your inbox becomes a planned task, not a constant distraction.

prioritization.title: See what matters first, one action at a time
prioritization.description: Every batch is automatically ranked 0-100 by importance based on your behavior patterns. Deal with the CEO's question first, not the Zoom recording notification.

workflow.title: Triage → Process workflow
workflow.description: New emails go to Triage for quick decisions. Starred emails move to Process for focused work. No more endless scrolling to find what needs attention.

snoozing.title: Smart snoozing that actually works
snoozing.description: Type "2h" or "tomorrow" to snooze. No calendar navigation, no complex scheduling.

mobile.paragraph1: I built BearlyMail because email was destroying my ability to focus.
mobile.paragraph2: As a software engineer, I need long blocks of uninterrupted time to write code. But email kept pulling me out of flow state. I'd check my inbox "just to see" and lose an hour responding to things that could wait.
mobile.paragraph3: I tried everything: inbox zero, Gmail filters, Superhuman. Nothing solved the core problem: email arrives when senders want it to, not when I want to see it.
mobile.paragraph4: So I built BearlyMail. Now, non-urgent emails arrive in scheduled batches. Urgent emails break through immediately. My inbox is a planned task, not a constant distraction.

desktop.paragraph1: I built BearlyMail because email was destroying my ability to focus.
desktop.paragraph2: As a software engineer, I need long blocks of uninterrupted time to write code. But email kept pulling me out of flow state. I'd check my inbox "just to see" and lose an hour responding to things that could wait.
desktop.paragraph3: I tried everything: inbox zero, Gmail filters, Superhuman. Nothing solved the core problem: email arrives when senders want it to, not when I want to see it.
desktop.paragraph4: So I built BearlyMail. Now, non-urgent emails arrive in scheduled batches. Urgent emails break through immediately. My inbox is a planned task, not a constant distraction.
desktop.paragraph5: The AI learns what's urgent to me by analyzing my email history—how quickly I reply, which senders I prioritize, what I immediately archive. High barrier for "urgent" means only what genuinely matters interrupts my flow.
desktop.paragraph6: If you're like me—someone who needs focus time to do your best work—BearlyMail is for you
